core_question: How do I tune a drum head so the pitch is even all the way around? (secondary: How do I stop a bicycle chain from squeaking due to being dry?)
answer_summary: Turn each tension rod a small, equal amount at a time in a star or crisscross sequence around the rim, checking pitch at each lug, so tension stays even across the head.; after the topic shift: Wipe the chain clean of old grime, drip bicycle-specific chain lubricant onto each link while backpedaling, let it soak in, then wipe off the excess so it doesn't attract dirt.
